wc:minerva-media-player.summary: Audio / video player with themed controls.
wc:minerva-media-player.description: An `<audio>` / `<video>` element with themed custom controls (`<MediaPlayer>` of React): play / pause, skip back / forward, a seek bar (`role=slider`, buffered range), the time, mute and volume, the playback speed (cycle button), fullscreen and picture-in-picture (video), and a captions menu when `tracks` are given (cues drawn by the player). Keyboard on the focused player: Space / K play-pause, ← / → seek by 5 s, ↑ / ↓ volume, M mute, F fullscreen, C captions on / off. Captions come from the `tracks` property or, when it is empty, from `<track src srclang label kind default>` children of the element. The media events don't cross the shadow root: they are re-dispatched as `minerva-*` events. `play()`, `pause()`, `seek(seconds)` and `element` drive the media from script.

properties.name: type
properties.description: Kind of media; default: inferred from `mime-type`, else from the file extension of `src`, else "video"

properties.name: mimeType
properties.description: MIME type of the media ("audio/mpeg", "video/mp4"...), used to infer `type`

properties.name: poster
properties.description: Image shown before a video plays

properties.name: autoPlay
properties.description: Starts playing as soon as possible (browsers only allow muted autoplay without a user gesture)

properties.name: muted
properties.description: Mutes the media; follows the mute button and the M key

properties.name: preload
properties.description: How much of the media the browser loads before playback

properties.name: crossOrigin
properties.description: CORS mode of the media request (cross-origin caption files need it too, plus CORS headers on their server)

properties.name: startTime
properties.description: Resume position in seconds, applied once when the metadata loads (and again when `src` changes)

properties.name: skipSeconds
properties.description: Step of the skip back / forward buttons, in seconds (0 hides them)

properties.name: noControls
properties.description: Hides the custom control bar: renders the bare media element (drive it from script)

properties.name: height
properties.description: Height of a video player (CSS length; a bare number is pixels); overrides `aspect-ratio`

properties.name: aspectRatio
properties.description: Aspect ratio of a video player (CSS aspect-ratio)

properties.name: pictureInPicture
properties.description: Shows a picture-in-picture button (video, where the browser supports it)

properties.name: playbackRates
properties.description: Speeds the speed button cycles through (default [0.5, 0.75, 1, 1.25, 1.5, 2])

properties.name: tracks
properties.description: Captions / subtitles (WebVTT or SRT files, JS property): drawn by the player over the video (below the title for audio), with a captions menu in the control bar. The choice is remembered (localStorage); a `default` track shows until the user chooses. Empty: the `<track>` children are used

properties.name: element
properties.description: The rendered `<audio>` / `<video>` element (null before the first render)

methods.name: play
methods.description: Starts playback (autoplay-policy rejections are swallowed: the player stays paused)

methods.name: seek
methods.description: Moves the playhead to `seconds` (clamped to the duration)

translationResources.title: MediaPlayer
translationResources.description: An audio or video player with themed custom controls: play / pause, skip, a seek bar with the buffered range, time, volume, playback speed and fullscreen, operable from the keyboard.

video.title: Video
video.description: A <video> with a dark translucent control bar that fades out while playing (it stays visible on touch screens, on hover and on focus). Focus the player: Space / K play-pause, ← / → seek by 5 s, ↑ / ↓ volume, M mute, F fullscreen. pictureInPicture adds a button where the browser supports it.

audio.title: Audio
audio.description: The type is inferred from mimeType or the file extension (video otherwise); audio renders a surface bar with the title. skipSeconds={0} hides the skip buttons.

resume.title: Resume and progress
resume.description: startTime is applied once when the metadata loads (resume where the learner stopped). onTimeUpdate / onLoadedMetadata / onPause / onEnded report the progress; the ref exposes play(), pause(), seek(seconds) and the media element.

rates-skip.title: Speeds and skip step
rates-skip.description: playbackRates lists the speeds the speed button cycles through (onRateChange reports the new one); skipSeconds sets the step of the back / forward buttons; aspectRatio (or height) sizes a video.

captions.title: Captions
captions.description: tracks takes WebVTT or SRT files ({ src, srclang, label, kind, default }; data: URLs here). They are rendered as <track> children, but the player draws the active cue itself (over the video, below the title for audio) so captions look the same in every browser. The CC button opens a menu (Off and one item per track); C toggles captions on the focused player. The choice is remembered (localStorage) and a default track shows until the user chooses; onTrackChange reports it. Cross-origin caption files need crossOrigin="anonymous" (or "use-credentials") on the player and CORS headers on their server.

MediaPlayerProps.type: Kind of media; inferred from mimeType, else from the file extension of src, else "video"
MediaPlayerProps.mimeType: MIME type of the media ("audio/mpeg", "video/mp4"...), used to infer type
MediaPlayerProps.poster: Image shown before a video plays
MediaPlayerProps.title: Title of the media, shown in the audio bar / over the video
MediaPlayerProps.autoPlay: Starts playing as soon as possible (browsers only allow muted autoplay without a user gesture)
MediaPlayerProps.muted: Mutes the media; applied whenever it changes (the mute button still toggles the sound)
MediaPlayerProps.preload: How much of the media the browser loads before playback
MediaPlayerProps.crossOrigin: CORS mode of the media request (cross-origin caption files need it too, plus CORS headers on their server)
MediaPlayerProps.startTime: Resume position in seconds, applied once when the metadata loads (and again when src changes)
MediaPlayerProps.playbackRates: Speeds the speed button cycles through
MediaPlayerProps.skipSeconds: Step of the skip back / forward buttons, in seconds (0 hides them)
MediaPlayerProps.controls: Shows the custom control bar; false renders the bare media element (drive it through the ref)
MediaPlayerProps.height: Height of a video player (number: pixels); overrides aspectRatio
MediaPlayerProps.aspectRatio: Aspect ratio of a video player (CSS aspect-ratio)
MediaPlayerProps.pictureInPicture: Shows a picture-in-picture button (video, where the browser supports it)
MediaPlayerProps.tracks: Captions / subtitles: WebVTT or SRT files ({ src, srclang, label, kind, default }) rendered as <track> children and drawn by the player, with a captions menu in the control bar; the choice is remembered (localStorage)
MediaPlayerProps.onTimeUpdate: Called while playing with the playhead position and the duration ({ currentTime, duration }, seconds)
MediaPlayerProps.onEnded: Called when playback reaches the end
MediaPlayerProps.onLoadedMetadata: Called with the duration once the metadata is loaded ({ duration })
MediaPlayerProps.onError: Called with the MediaError when the media can't be loaded or played
MediaPlayerProps.onRateChange: Called with the new playback speed
MediaPlayerProps.onVolumeChange: Called when the volume or the muted state changes ({ volume, muted })
MediaPlayerProps.onTrackChange: Called when the user chooses captions ({ index, track }; index -1 and track null: Off)
MediaPlayerProps.aria-label: Accessible label of the player (defaults to title, else "Media player")
MediaPlayerProps.style: Inline styles of the root element
MediaPlayerProps.ref: Imperative handle: play(), pause(), seek(seconds), element

MediaPlayerHandle.play: Starts playback (the promise of HTMLMediaElement.play(); autoplay rejections are swallowed)
MediaPlayerHandle.seek: Moves the playhead to seconds (clamped to the duration)

MediaPlayerTrack.src: URL of the WebVTT (.vtt) or SubRip (.srt) file; data: URLs work
MediaPlayerTrack.srclang: Language of the track (BCP 47: "en", "fr-CA"), also what the remembered choice matches
MediaPlayerTrack.label: Name shown in the captions menu
MediaPlayerTrack.default: Shown when the user has not chosen captions yet

basic.title: MediaControls (React Native)
basic.description: Core React Native has no media element: MediaControls is the themed control bar, driven by props (playing, currentTime, duration, buffered, muted, playbackRate) and callbacks (onPlayPause, onSeek, onMutedChange, onRateChange...). Wire it to expo-video / expo-audio (see the comment in the code); this preview simulates the player.

captions.title: Captions (React Native)
captions.description: React Native players have no text tracks: with tracks, MediaControls fetches the WebVTT / SRT file (data: URLs work), parses it and draws the cue at currentTime above the seek bar. The CC button shows an Off / per-track choice; trackIndex can be controlled and onTrackChange reports the choice.
